approach.desc1: We address the root of conditions—not only symptoms—by analyzing how your biological systems interconnect.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Clear and scalable options according to your needs.
services.desc1: In-depth 60–90 minute consultation. Comprehensive medical history review, integral lab analysis from a functional perspective, root cause identification, and personalized written plan delivered within 24 hours.
services.desc2: Progress evaluation, personalized nutritional adjustments, hormonal optimization if needed, supplementation review, medical treatment management, and establishment of achievable monthly goals.
services.desc3: Ideal for complex cases, intensive protocol initiation, significant hormonal changes, or when close monitoring is required. More frequent adjustments for optimal results.
services.desc4: Detailed functional reading of your laboratory results. Biomarker explanation, pattern and trend identification. Recommendations based on optimal values, not just normal ranges. Educational session included.
services.desc5: Consultations in the comfort of your home in San Pedro and Monterrey. Ideal for patients with limited mobility, elderly adults, or those who prefer private care. Availability according to area and schedule.
services.desc6: VIP continuous support with priority attention. Direct WhatsApp access for quick consultations. Metric tracking and progress monitoring with monthly report. Discounts at partner laboratories. Prescription renewals without additional consultation.

tshape.title: T-Shape 2
tshape.subtitle: Cutting-edge FDA-approved technology for advanced body treatments.
tshape.fdaDesc: The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has confirmed that T-SHAPE2 and its handpieces are specifically indicated for:
tshape.fdaNote: This recognition is not only a testament to the safety of our technology, but also confirms the efficacy of the claimed results, which are now certified and guaranteed by the FDA.
tshape.tech1Desc: The combination of bipolar Radiofrequency and LLLT Laser creates intense thermal heat in connective tissues, including the fibrous septum. This heat promotes increased collagen deposits and accelerates cellular metabolism, resulting in a remarkable localized reduction of volume and skin laxity.
tshape.tech2Desc: Vacuum aspiration generates an immediate increase in blood circulation and lymphatic drainage, both essential for improving overall health. It also contributes to greater tissue oxygenation and the elimination of accumulated toxins, promoting healthier and more radiant skin.
tshape.tech3Desc: The handpiece equipped with automatic rotation and sphere pressure delivers micro-vibration directly to the tissues. This enables a complete treatment of skin and muscles, stimulating circulation and promoting muscle tone.

a1.title: A guide to balanced eating
a1.body:
Balanced eating combines protein, healthy fats, complex carbohydrates, and micronutrients in every meal.

Prioritize whole foods, colorful vegetables, and steady hydration. Small, sustainable changes usually work better than restrictive diets.

a2.title: Effective routines for every age
a2.body:
Regular movement improves cardiovascular health, mood, and bone density.

Match intensity to your age and condition: light strength work, walking, and joint mobility are safe foundations for most people.

a3.title: Techniques to reduce stress
a3.body:
Chronic stress affects sleep, digestion, and immune function.

Diaphragmatic breathing, mindful breaks, and clear work boundaries help restore balance. If symptoms persist, talk to a professional.

a4.title: Essential medical checkups
a4.body:
Periodic checkups help detect risk factors before they become disease.

Labs, blood pressure, and age-appropriate screenings are core parts of personalized preventive care.

a5.title: Healthy habits for everyday life
a5.body:
Good sleep, movement, and social connection are pillars of wellbeing.

Build small, repeatable routines: regular schedules, unhurried meals, and real rest.
